title: A Regularised Wallis Hierarchy
summary: A hierarchy of regularised Wallis products is introduced by raising the reciprocal Wallis factor \[ 1-\frac1{n^2} \] to the polynomial weight $n^m$, $m=0,1,2,\ldots$. For each $m$, a minimal exponential counterterm is chosen by cancelling precisely the non-summable terms in the logarithmic expansion. This gives a convergent product $P_m$ the logarithm of which is an explicit zeta-function tail.
